brief.subject: SBA trims surety bond paperwork; IRS fixes QOZ reporting rule
brief.headline: SBA Streamlines Surety Bond Guarantee Program; IRS Corrects Opportunity Zone Reporting Plan
brief.dek: A final SBA rule cuts surety paperwork, the IRS corrects proposed QOZ reporting rules, and a tax credit hearing moves to phone only.
brief.lede: The SBA finalized a rule cutting document submission and retention burdens in its Surety Bond Guarantee program, a lifeline for small contractors who need bonding.

sections.heading: SBA Surety Bond Rule Finalized
bullets: The SBA issued a final rule modernizing its Surety Bond Guarantee program regulations.
Participating surety companies face lighter document submission and retention requirements, which could ease bonding for small contractors.
The rule also fixes conflicting provisions in the program's regulations.
Outdated Preferred Surety admissions requirements and the Quarterly Contract Completion Report are being revised.

sections.heading: IRS Corrects QOZ Reporting Proposal
bullets: The IRS published corrections to proposed regulations REG-116506-25, first released on September 11, 2026.
Qualified opportunity funds would file information returns and send statements to investors who dispose of their investments.
Qualified opportunity zone businesses would also furnish statements to the funds holding interests in them.
Bookkeepers serving QOZ businesses should note these new statement duties as the rules take shape.

sections.heading: Scholarship Credit Hearing Goes Phone-Only
bullets: The December 15, 2026 hearing on the federal scholarship tax credit proposal is now telephonic only.
The proposal, REG-117199-25, covers a non-refundable credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
Clients planning such contributions should track the guidance as it develops.

sections.heading: IRS E-Filing Panel Adds Members
bullets: The IRS named 10 new members to the Electronic Tax Administration Advisory Committee.
The committee, created by statute in 1998, serves as a public forum on electronic tax administration issues.

items.title: Rule: Surety Bond Guarantee Program: Streamlining and Modernizing
items.snippet: This final rule makes several changes to the U.S. Small Business Administration (SBA) Surety Bond Guarantee (SBG) program regulations. The rule reduces the burden on participating surety companies for submission and retention of documents. The rule also corrects conflicting provisions, as well as revising the obsolete Preferred Surety admissions requirements and the Quarterly Contract Completion Report.

items.title: Proposed Rule: Information Reporting Regarding Qualified Opportunity Zones and Updated Qualified Opportunity Fund Certification and Decertification Procedures; Correction
items.snippet: This document contains corrections to the proposed regulations (REG-116506-25), published in the Federal Register on September 11, 2026. These proposed regulations would implement new statutory requirements for qualified opportunity funds to file information returns with the IRS and furnish statements to investors who dispose of investments in those entities and for qualified opportunity zone businesses to furnish statements to qualified opportunity funds that hold interests in them.
